sources.excerpt: It is often said that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made object

reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye—let alone the only man-made structure visible—is a well-documented myth. The Great Wall is only a few meters wide and constructed from materials that blend into the surrounding terrain, making it virtually impossible to distinguish with the unaided human eye from low Earth orbit or from the Moon. Conversely, numerous other human-made features, such as major highways, large bridges, airport runways, dams, and city lights at night, are far more visible from low Earth orbit without optical aid.
